verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email API that provisions its own hosted inboxes. Connecting external accounts is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to link Gmail, Microsoft 365 or arbitrary IMAP accounts into AgentMail. The IMAP/SMTP doc covers the opposite direction: external clients like Outlook connecting to an AgentMail inbox. Custom domains only affect sending identity and do not aggregate third-party accounts.
